# distortion / spin

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventTypeDistortion`](gmeow-eventTypeDistortion.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventTypeDistortion>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)

A deception event in which the projected standpoint sharpens, re-frames, or selectively emphasises the held standpoint — a modality shift (e.g. probable→unequivocal) or a re-contextualisation that changes the inferential landscape without literally falsifying the source. The spin doctor ([`gmeow:roleSpinDoctor`](gmeow-roleSpinDoctor.md)) is a participant role specific to this type. Violates the Gricean maxim of Manner.
